title: Paired Instructions · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paired Instructions · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and agree on a simple shape. One player describes the shape without naming it while the partner draws. The group recognizes the intended shape in the drawing. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paired Instructions, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group recognizes the intended shape in the drawing.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group recognizes the intended shape in the drawing.
